The primary material of a candle is wax.

Regarding the operational processes described in the text, the main bottleneck is the location of the central repository for tools and materials. Because workers must travel significant distances across the work site to retrieve items, there is lost productivity due to excessive commuting time between the repository and various construction areas. An efficiency improvement would be to decentralize the storage of tools and materials or to place them closer to active work zones to reduce travel time and increase productivity.
